baseline: joint_ema.pt from PROTOCOL.json; frozen 1.47M-parameter four-frame model
policy: 20-step eta=1 stochastic DDIM on 4x28x28 videos, 19 nonterminal diagonal Gaussian transitions; exact joint conditional action log density, deterministic terminal step
adapter: zero-initialized 3D convolutional residual on predicted noise, frozen joint backbone
step_selection: one uniform step from each of [0,6), [6,12), [12,19), deterministic by training seed and update
reward: proxy MNIST classifier confidence times same-class fraction, plus bounded centroid smoothness; hard ink/movement validity guard. Independent gold classifier is not queried during RL.
primary_comparison: trained adapter minus zero adapter on paired initial and transition noise, for proxy reward and independent gold digit confidence/class consistency
stop_rule: No GRPO if baseline gate fails; stop seed on nonfinite sample/loss/gradient or >50% ratio clipping for five consecutive updates; no paid compute
claim_scope: toy Moving-MNIST video diffusion trained locally from an existing MNIST image prior; no cinematic-video claim
